chunks: But nothing will avail you on that day, for you were unjust, and you will be partners in the punishment.

key_terms.ظَلَمْتُمْ: You were unjust / You did wrong

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the fate of the unjust on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the ultimate equality of the unjust in the Hereafter, stripping away the hierarchical distinctions of worldly power and wealth that defined their lives. It serves as a profound reminder that rejection of divine truth leads to a shared fate of punishment, emphasizing that spiritual status is determined by faith and justice rather than material accumulation. This highlights the Shia concept of 'Adl (Divine Justice), where the scale of deeds outweighs social rank.
